units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:36">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>עבד ת׳ שחיק וכ׳</he> had ground garlic prepared in his house.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:27">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ההן דשחק ת׳</he> he that grinds garlic (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:11">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ יחידאה</he> a single-headed garlic plant.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00515"><he>שׁוּפְתָּא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="V00230"><he>תּוּמַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>תּוּמֵי</he>.
